messages.subject: [GSoC-R] Phase 1 (June) evaluations now open
parts:
Phase 1 project evaluations are now live on the summerofcode website.

These need to be completed by Friday's Google deadline.

Mentors: please do these as soon as possible.

If these aren't done before Friday Morning's deadline, I'll
automatically be entering failing evaluations.

Students: I hope that your projects are going well, and that you are
more or less on track with your project plan. If you have any
concerns, please bring them to the attention of your mentors, Toby, and
me as soon as possible.

Each evaluation should take only a few minutes to fill out. The
longest part is free-form feedback for the student and Google.

Regards,

Brian

--
